messages:
omar (billing): quick sync after the postmortem: recurring token-drift observed across 4 customers over the last 2 weeks. we need owners for detection, backlog backfill, customer outreach, and runbook updates.
eva (finance): i'll own crediting and invoice adjustments. need a vetted CSV of invoice_id, token_delta, usd_credit.
sam (eng-infra): i'll own detection + an automated daily report. plan: metric 'token_drift_count' per-customer and rule -> #metering-alerts. ETA 48h.
leo (eng-sre): root cause preliminary: occasional consumer stall on shard 7 during GC spikes leading to late attribution. working on a small GC tuning + consumer watchdog. PR by EOD, rollout after smoke tests.
anya (customer-success): i'll prepare templated outreach for affected customers. prefer two tiers: automated note for small credits, AE-assisted for accounts > $5k MRR.
eva (finance): policy question: threshold for auto-credit vs manual review? propose auto-credit for <= 1% monthly variance or <= $250 USD.
omar (billing): approve that policy. add a column 'requires_ae' for >$5k MRR and 'requires_manual_review' for >$250 USD.
sam (eng-infra): detection rule will emit a ticket MET-4802 with sample trace and estimated token delta. also adding a daily aggregate job to surface customers with >3 incidents in 7d. ETA 5d for that job.
leo (eng-sre): mitigation timeline: GC tuning PR today, watchdog + restart policy in 2 days, canary rollout 3 days. will include histogram 'late_attribution_ms' for visibility.
eva (finance): once detection runs, i'll generate the AR CSV. target: apply credits within 2 business days for auto-credit cases; manual review up to 7 days.
anya (customer-success): i'll draft the two templates and a short FAQ. will include "how credits show on invoice" wording and timing. sharing in 24h.
billing-bot: Ticket MET-4802 created: "token_drift_daily_report" assigned to eng-infra.
omar (billing): action recap: sam -> detection + MET-4802 (48h); leo -> GC tuning + watchdog (PR today, rollout 3d); eva -> credit runbook & AR CSV after detection (2bd autos, 7bd manual); anya -> comms + FAQ (24h). i'll update the follow-up doc and schedule a 72h checkpoint. :white_check_mark:
